```{r library import, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(GGally)
```

```{r data import}
radial_raw <- read.csv("../../../data/processed/radial_img_processing_results/prop_adair_image_results.csv")

prop_adair <- radial_raw[1:144, ]
prop_picos <- radial_raw[145:nrow(radial_raw), ]

picos_join <- read.csv("../../../metadata/join_tables/prop_picos_join_table.csv")
adair_join <- read.csv("../../../metadata/join_tables/prop_adair_join_table.csv")
```

```{r data cleaning}

# ASI weights
alpha = 0.5
beta = 0.5

# Cleaning 
prop_adair <- prop_adair %>% 
        mutate(
                row = sub("(^\\d{2})([A-Z])_.*", "17\\2", image_name),
                tree = sub("(^\\d{2})[A-Z]_.*", "\\1", image_name),
                sys_id = paste(row, tree, sep = "_")
        ) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(row, tree)) %>% 
        left_join(adair_join, by = 'sys_id') %>% 
        rowwise() %>% 
        mutate(
                ASI = (alpha * variance_PC1 + beta * center_offset) / convex_hull_area,
                ASI_scaled = ASI / (1 + ASI)
        )

prop_picos <- prop_picos %>% 
        mutate(
                row = sub("(^\\d{2})_.*", "\\1", image_name),
                tree = as.character(as.numeric(sub("(^\\d{2})_(\\d{2})_.*", "\\2", image_name))),
                sys_id = paste(row, tree, sep='_')
        ) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(row, tree)) %>% 
        left_join(picos_join, by = 'sys_id') %>% 
        rowwise() %>% 
        mutate(
                ASI = (alpha * variance_PC1 + beta * center_offset) / convex_hull_area,
                ASI_scaled = ASI / (1 + ASI)
        )
```

```{r Convex Hull Area}
picos_ch_mm <- lmer(convex_hull_area ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=prop_picos)
anova(picos_ch_mm)
picos_ch_emm <- emmeans(picos_ch_mm, specs = c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs:prop_type))
cld(picos_ch_emm$`emmeans of rs`, Letters = letters, reversed=TRUE)
cld(picos_ch_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters = letters, reversed=TRUE)
cld(picos_ch_emm$`emmeans of rs, prop_type`, Letters = letters, reversed=TRUE)

ggplot(prop_picos, aes(x=rs, y=convex_hull_area, fill=rs)) + 
        geom_boxplot() +
        facet_wrap(~prop_type)

interaction.plot(prop_picos$rs, prop_picos$prop_type, prop_picos$convex_hull_area)




adair_ch_mm <- lmer(convex_hull_area ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=prop_adair)
anova(adair_ch_mm)
adair_ch_emm <- emmeans(adair_ch_mm, specs = c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs:prop_type))
cld(adair_ch_emm$`emmeans of rs`, Letters = letters, reversed=TRUE)
cld(adair_ch_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters = letters, reversed=TRUE)
cld(adair_ch_emm$`emmeans of rs, prop_type`, Letters = letters, reversed=TRUE)

ggplot(prop_adair, aes(x=rs, y=convex_hull_area, fill=rs)) + 
        geom_boxplot() +
        facet_wrap(~prop_type)

interaction.plot(prop_adair$rs, prop_adair$prop_type, prop_adair$convex_hull_area)

```

```{r}
ft1 <- prop_picos %>% 
        mutate(trial = "ft1")
ft2 <- prop_adair %>% 
        mutate(trial = "ft2")
combined_data = rbind(ft1, ft2)
combined_data
```

```{r}
combined_asi_mm <- lmer(ASI_scaled ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block) + (1|trial), data=combined_data)
```

```{r}
summary(combined_data)

combined_data %>% 
        group_by(trial) %>% 
        summarize(
                mean_asi = mean(ASI_scaled),
                std_asi = sd(ASI_scaled)
        )

ggplot(combined_data, aes(x=rs, y=ASI_scaled, fill=rs, group=rs))+
        geom_boxplot()+
        facet_wrap(~trial)
```

```{r}
subset_data = combined_data %>% 
        select(convex_hull_area, solidity, root_area, variance_PC1, center_offset, ASI, log(ASI_scaled))
ggpairs(subset_data)
```

```{r}
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x=log(ASI), y=convex_hull_area, color=rs))+
        geom_point()+
        scale_color_viridis_d(option='A') +
        geom_smooth(method = 'glm')+
        facet_wrap(~prop_type)

```
